components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action: bone white on obsidian, 8px radius, compact mono label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); color: var(--obsidian-ground, #141414); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet chrome action: transparent, ash text, charcoal hover wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--charcoal-hover, #2a2a2a); color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Compact 24px mono search field with a Pencil hairline and a left icon inset.
components.html: <label class="ds-input"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="12" height="12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.34-4.34"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search…" aria-label="Search sessions" /></label>
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 12px 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--pencil-line, #434343); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.3); color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); position: relative; } .ds-input svg { position: absolute; left: 6px; color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); } .ds-input input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-input input::placeholder { color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); } .ds-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); }

components.name: Option Row
components.description: A quiz or probe answer row: 12px rectangle, hairline edge, charcoal fill plus bone edge when selected.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--pencil-line, #434343); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-option:hover { background: rgba(42, 42, 42, 0.5); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); } .ds-option-selected { background: var(--charcoal-hover, #2a2a2a); border-color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-radio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: 1px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.4); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-option-selected .ds-radio { border-color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); background: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--obsidian-ground, #141414); }

components.name: Transcript Card
components.description: The flat graphite card that holds a question, problem, or answered check; no shadow.

components.css: .ds-card { width: 100%; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pencil-line, #434343); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--graphite-panel, #1c1c1c); color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-eyebrow { margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Verdict Chip
components.description: The only place hue is allowed in content: a 15% tint with solid hue text.
components.html: correct incorrect solved with hints
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-correct { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15); color: var(--signal-correct, #22c55e); } .ds-incorrect { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15); color: var(--signal-incorrect, #ef4444); } .ds-hint { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15); color: var(--signal-hint, #f59e0b); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The signature bottom shell: 16px graphite card, float shadow, transparent field and bone send square.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--pencil-line, #434343); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--graphite-panel, #1c1c1c); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); } .ds-composer-field { flex: 1; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; outline: none; color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-composer-field:empty::before { content: attr(data-placeholder); color: var(--ash, #8d8d8d); pointer-events: none; } .ds-send { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); color: var(--obsidian-ground, #141414); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-send:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); }

components.name: Tooltip Chip
components.description: A quiet charcoal label with the shortcut in parentheses; no arrow.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--charcoal-hover, #2a2a2a); color: rgba(230, 230, 230, 0.85); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; white-space: nowrap; }

components.css: .ds-code { position: relative; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--pencil-line, #434343); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #141414 86%, black); color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-code pre { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-code code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-copy { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.7); opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-code:hover .ds-copy, .ds-copy:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-copy:hover { background: var(--charcoal-hover, #2a2a2a); color: var(--bone-white, #e6e6e6); } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(141, 141, 141, 0.5); }

narrative.overview: LearnHarness is a dark instrument for reading what someone understands. The screen is an obsidian field; the chrome is a thin, precise mono voice; the teaching text is set like a page under glass. Nothing glows for attention. Light is information: a bone-white action, a selected edge, a verdict. The interface stays quiet so the learner's reasoning, the question, and the graph remain the brightest things in the room. The register is editorial and austere rather than technical for its own sake. CMU Serif titles announce a session the way a plate announces an exhibit; JetBrains Mono labels operate the instrument; Source Sans 3 carries the reading. Surfaces are flat panes separated by 1px pencil lines, with shadow reserved for things that genuinely float above the page. Component feel is a tactile drafting tool: controls are compact, squared-off, and firm under the hand. Selection is a tone shift plus a bone-white edge, never a glow.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian ground, graphite panels, one step of tone per surface.
One accent only: bone white. Hue is reserved for verdicts and system status.
Three typographic voices: serif announces, mono operates, Source Sans 3 explains.
Hairline borders define every surface; floating shadows mark true z-lift.
A 4px rhythm and a 4/8/12/16px radius ladder.
Motion is state, not decoration: 120–200ms fades and rises.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Bone White is the only accent. Keep it under roughly 10% of any screen; its rarity is what makes it read as light rather than paint.

rules.name: The Graphite Stack Rule
rules.body: Surfaces climb one step: Obsidian ground → Graphite panel → Charcoal hover. Recessed content may sit one step below ground; never introduce a fourth decorative gray.

rules.name: The Verdict-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Hue appears only for answer verdicts or system status. It never becomes a brand accent, a phase color, a gradient stop, or decoration.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Mono is chrome; Source Sans 3 is reading; CMU Serif is announcement. Never swap roles — no serif controls, no mono paragraphs, no prose in the sidebar chrome.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No label, badge, or metadata text goes below 11px. Quiet comes from Ash, tracking, and case, not from shrinking the type.

rules.name: The 16px Reading Rule
rules.body: Teaching prose and tables stay at 16px. The reading surface is the product; the instrument around it may be 11–14px.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Every padding, margin, gap, and control height is a whole multiple of 4px. No hand-tuned exceptions.

rules.name: The 46rem Reading Rule
rules.body: Composer, dock, transcript, and empty-state summary share one 46rem column. A surface that changes the column width changes the reading rhythm and is out of system.

rules.name: The Floating-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If it does not overlap other content, it does not cast a shadow. Cards, rows, navigation, and panels stay flat.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Elevation is a 1px Pencil line before it is ever a shadow. Thickening a border to 2px to signal emphasis is out of system; use tone or a bone-white edge instead.

rules.name: The Two Silhouettes Rule
rules.body: Content is a rounded rectangle (12–16px). Controls that float over the canvas are a pill or an 8px-radius icon square. Circles belong to radios, selection dots, and avatars — never to content containers.

dos: Do keep Obsidian #141414 as the ground and Graphite #1c1c1c as the panel; every raised surface moves exactly one step.
Do use Bone White #e6e6e6 as the only accent and keep its coverage under roughly 10% of any screen.
Do set teaching prose and tables at 16px/1.5, labels at 11px uppercase mono with 0.05em tracking, and titles in CMU Serif.
Do stay on the 4px spacing rhythm and the 4/8/12/16px radius ladder.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Pencil hairlines before reaching for a shadow.
Do reserve shadows for elements that overlap other content (composer, menus, dialogs, node cards).
Do use hue only as a 15% verdict tint or a solid status dot/text, never as decoration.
Do animate state with 120–200ms ease-out fades and 4–6px rises; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the composer, dock, and transcript on the same 46rem column.
donts: Don't introduce a brand hue, gradient, neon glow, or colored primary button.
Don't use pure black or pure white; Obsidian and Bone White already carry the extremes.
Don't put shadows on transcript cards, option rows, navigation, or static panels.
Don't set serif type in controls or mono type in teaching prose.
Don't set reading text below 16px or labels below 11px.
Don't use pill shapes for content cards; pills are for floating metadata and compact canvas controls.
Don't use color to mark lesson phases or to decorate the graph; phase color-coding is retired and state belongs to motion and tone.
Don't restore a global browser focus outline; use border/tone state and the local keyboard rings the dock already provides.
Don't let code blocks or tables rebuild their own header chrome; they melt into the message as a single quiet block.
Don't add a fourth surface gray beyond ground, panel, hover, and the recessed code well.
